module: Native Windows PC frontend menu, local settings and presentation

files.adapted: Flat page/row navigation, bounded wraparound, selection/adjustment/accept/back actions, pause menu, controller-editable player-name flow.
PC preferences and bounded player-name handling (1242-1311), output-side volume intent (648-674), nearest/linear/sharp presentation (468-529), CRT mask shape and constants (131-179).
Unmodified full upstream license retained at third_party/tmnt-port/LICENSE.

adaptation.menu: Pure C++ page/action model; existing Win32 and XInput frontend owns rendering, effects and gameplay suppression. Original operator-menu action supplies the game sound test.
adaptation.settings: Versioned bounded parser with all-or-default validation and atomic replacement, separate from original arcade CMOS and input binding data. Local name limited to 10 normalized characters. Scripted captures do not save local preferences.
adaptation.video: Bounded CPU filter buffers replace SDL texture passes. Independent axes preserve Smash TV geometry; presentation filters do not alter source pixels. Player release remains fixed shared 16:9.
adaptation.audio: New device-copy gain/mute control follows donor output-side volume pattern; original emulated sound commands, mixer stream and timing remain under the existing coupled sound owner.
not_imported: TMNT game code, addresses, ROMs or assets
Donor gameplay networking or rollback core
adaptation.related_lobby: The separate arcade-lan-lobby adaptation and exact submodule provenance are recorded in third_party/arcade-lan-lobby/PROVENANCE.json.

distribution: Retain the full upstream license with authorized binaries as licenses/tmnt-port-LICENSE.txt and preserve source attribution. These upstream permissions do not grant rights to redistribute original Smash TV material.
